observations.readiness: Owned Vite API readiness and all three fresh Firefox launches completed in both runs.
observations.legacy: Every variant in both runs exceeded the 4.5-second DOM-ready and 2.5-second evaluate-before stages; none captured a legacy canvas or renderer.

push.click: Timeout after 3504.36 ms; later evaluate also timed out.

pr.click: Timeout after 3503.92 ms despite the log reaching visible, enabled, stable and scrolled into view.

observations.rendererCorrection: The PR captured actual WebGL metadata after the failed twin click in BOTH baseline-60 and software-WebRender variants. Earlier snapshots were null; a blanket no-renderer-captured statement is false for this report. Push captured no renderer.
observations.defaultClock: Both blank pages recorded 181 RAF callbacks in about three seconds versus 62/64 baseline-60 and 77/77 software-WebRender. The PR default twin click completed in 2741.20 ms, but its post-click canvas remained null and legacy still failed. Push default twin hit the global work budget, so it is incomplete.
observations.cleanup: Baseline and software-WebRender graceful closes exceeded two seconds in both runs. Public kill and owned-group absence checks completed before later fresh variants. PR default close was graceful. Push exhausted the 82-second worker work budget and reached the supervisor watchdog at 88.43 seconds; registered groups were reported absent after cleanup.

interpretation: COLLECTED means the diagnostic completed its bounded observations, including recorded per-page failures. It does not mean application acceptance passed.
Software-WebRender did not eliminate the recorded rendered-path stalls in these runs. A valid late WebGL context also does not establish a stable rendered scene or identify the stalled subsystem.
Native timer and RAF progress both show multi-second twin gaps; observations do not isolate compositor, compilation, startup, host scheduling or other causes.

Default-clock blank RAF progress is higher in both runs, but variants always ran in the same order. This is not an order-controlled causal comparison or evidence that reverting the preference would pass the full suite.
The normal full CI outcomes are outside this review and remain required.
actions: Read and summarized local downloaded JSON only; no public copies, source/configuration edits, tests, remote writes or candidate changes.
